title: Interactive Fiction on Baize: ZIL-to-Baize translator (Path B)
description: Static world model extraction from ZIL source: rooms to graph nodes, objects to components, exits to edges, properties to node_properties. Then compile ZIL action routines/daemons to WASM GameExtension functions. Requires: ZIL parser (s-expressions), world model extractor, ZIL-to-WASM compiler for behavioral code. 2-3 month compiler project. The interesting path — Baize owns the map and inventory, WASM owns the behaviors. Speculative/crazy project.
